outcome: Serum lipid levels (TC, TG, LDL-C, HDL-C)
Recommended reference ranges for serum lipid concentrations during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 20,365 pregnant women in their first trimester recruited from Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital.
finding: Levothyroxine (L-T4) treatment was found to significantly improve total cholesterol (TC) and LDL-C levels in pregnant women with subclinical hypothyroidism (SCH).
